title: Follow the decoupling rule
story: Our board rule says: no supply may sag more than 150 mV when a load switches on. A 5 V battery reaches the board through leads with 0.05 ohm and 0.5 uH. At t = 5 us a 5 ohm load (about 1 A) switches on. Choose the decoupling capacitor that goes right at the load (every capacitor in the tray starts charged to 5 V). Keep vdd at or above 4.85 V for the whole run.
hints: The lead inductance cannot change its current instantly, so the capacitor supplies the first microseconds of load current.
The deepest dip is about I * sqrt(L / C) with I = 1 A and L = 0.5 uH.
